title: Shady tactics

I instantly closed the window and deleted the app. Doing that is morally wrong. 1 you only offered that after seeing if we agreed to the more expensive plan first. 2: I never got to look at or try the app. No free trial, no offer to check the app out. Instantly: give us money. And if you donΓÇÖt do it now, it will be more expensive later.

That is a bully technique. Would not recommend this predatory app.
